segments.title: Harris CNN Interview & NASA TV Shutdown
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple dissect Kamala Harris's first CNN interview as nominee — border bill, Gaza ceasefire rhetoric, Roger Rabbit voice comparisons — then pivot to NASA TV moving to streaming-only.

segments.title: Sword Wolf, Circus Teen, Trumpy Trout, David's Pizza
segments.notes: Case, Jeff, and Liliana rate viral clips: a longsword-wielding wolf, a 16-year-old circus performer, the animatronic Trumpy Trout fish ($60, arbitration clause), and a David's Pizza jingle that triggers a 5-sub hype train.

segments.title: Past-Life President Panel
segments.notes: Chet, Liliana, Grandma Crumble Bottom, Tyler, and Groglin play a secret-liar round: one was a U.S. president in a past life. Chat votes Liliana; reveal shows Grandma Crumble Bottom was James Garfield (and/or Jon Arbuckle).

segments.title: Mole Defends JD Vance, Fake Miles Taylor, Frankenstein, Ghost Pat Robertson, Tom Cruise, Godzilla
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park denizens: an Ohio mole sympathizing with JD Vance, a doppelganger who booked the real Miles Taylor five 12-hour flights, a 'shitty face' Frankenstein courting Trip's sister bush, the pissing ghost of Pat Robertson, a low-effort Tom Cruise recruiting Trip into Scientology, the real Miles Taylor returning, a mobile-game mayor, and a tiny Godzilla failing to dab.

segments.title: World Robot Conference 2024: Five Humanoids
segments.notes: Case solo-reviews Beijing's humanoid showcase: AstroBot (cat care, waffles), Navigator (simulated suicide/sex), AdjiBot (melancholy), Wanda (cheese soup, murder cleanup), Optimus (squats, eggs). Chat poll crowns September 'best robot'.

segments.title: Tamagotchi Eggshell Casing
segments.notes: Brief closer: new Tamagotchi model uses recycled eggshell plastic; Case debates eating it.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Pepito rates the stream, Case announces September 8 Candyland RPG special (11 AM PT) and Monday call-cast, then raids Ashley's channel.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored full broadcast: Harris interview breakdown, Amongst the Web, Jambalaya host, robot conference review, and sign-off; self-disclosed ADD on air.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Extended freestyle workout rap over trap beats — piss hate, trap gains, salad pamphlets — survived 10+ minutes on Tam Tran's 10-sub fuel.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted News desk and Amongst the Web; read Harris clips, debated border/Gaza, rated sword wolf and Trumpy Trout.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Jambalaya contestant; claimed Superman bullet dreams, battle-toad/Stitch hybrid body, ordered drone strikes via Papa John's.

characters.name: Grandma Crumble Bottom
characters.notes: guest. Jambalaya contestant; claimed 1960s bullet wounds, inspired 50 Cent's name, rode horse-and-buggy rock-throwing 'drone strikes', revealed as James Garfield/Jon Arbuckle.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: guest. Jambalaya contestant; framed hierarchy as inverted pyramid, equated EDM drone shows to 'drone strikes of love', denied presidency.

characters.name: Groglin
characters.notes: puppet. Jambalaya mascot; claimed Groglin presidency, pacifist species, sticky mouth; Chet declared them best friends.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosted Trip on the Street from bush; interviewed mole, fake/real Miles Taylor, Frankenstein, ghost Pat Robertson, Tom Cruise, mayor, tiny Godzilla.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Briefly emerged from wall to drink sink water like a deer; ordered back by Case.

storylines.beat: [01:05:20] Case references Beyblade Tournament pledge: 'September featuring rock a fire incredible what a team up' — linking September sub-goal to Rock-afire gorilla backing.

lore_notes.fact: [02:21:41] Self-discloses ADD: 'honestly dude I got fuckin ADD like it's about time that I fucking admitted dude'.
[00:35:08] Birthday was months ago; wished for camera lens, not world peace.
[02:33:22] Next stream: September 8 Candyland RPG special with sketch group at 11 AM PT / 2 PM ET; call-cast Monday.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a work-heavy week to anchor a marathon broadcast: dissecting Kamala Harris's CNN interview with Jeff Ripple, rating viral clips from sword wolves to Trumpy Trout, hosting a Jambalaya past-life presidency panel won by Grandma Crumble Bottom (Garfield/Arbuckle), sending Trip Bradstein into a bush gauntlet of moles, doppelgangers, Frankensteins, and a tiny Godzilla, then solo-reviewing Beijing's melancholy humanoid robots before a brief Tamagotchi eggshell closer and a raid on Ashley's channel.
